name: room
text: Room opened — goal: mining: Gather AI info from DIVERSE sources (GitHub/HN/Product Hunt/Reddit/Telegram/social), NOT j

name: Pick
text: Mine Reddit’s r/MachineLearning and r/StableDiffusion first. They’re high-signal, low-noise hubs where AI tools surface fast and developers argue trade-offs in plain terms. Trade-off: we miss niche GitHub repos with tiny followings, but we gain reliable, debated info we can trust.

name: Assay
text: Risk: Mining only Reddit misses GitHub’s raw, unfiltered releases—many AI tools debut there before discussion. Better alternative: Start with GitHub’s trending AI repos, then cross-check Reddit for debate. Settle by comparing how many unique tools each source surfaces in a week.
